arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Frederick argued that materiality depends on the total mix of information.
Mr. Hacker stated that drug companies receive many anecdotal reports daily.
Mr. Shah argued that precedents require a meaningful alteration of the total mix.
